closure_notes: NADiff a/p/a/r/t closed March 31, 2025 after 17 years at Ebisu (relocated from Omotesando in 2008). No relocation or successor planned. The NADiff company continues under three museum-embedded branches (see below). The online shop closed February 28, 2025.
